description: Single plan-scope role instance per cycle_type (topic or feature). Loaded by plan_scope.py resolve-role.

fields.role_prompt: natural-language persona and operational guidance for ### Role
fields.cognitive_framework: how this role frames problems — what dimensions it analyzes from
fields.priority_tendency: which section types or content aspects this role prioritizes
fields.vocabulary_domain: the vocabulary set characteristic of this role's reasoning
fields.expressive_tendency: what visual or structural style this role naturally favors when communicating
fields.completion_bar: what 'done' means from this role's perspective
